source_refs.note: Exercise 12.1, Question 5 (book page 230): eleven limits in terms of e, parts (i)-(xi). (x) denominator printed e^(1/x) - 1 (limit 1); key -1 fits e^(1/x) + 1 as in (xi). Other key answers agree. Solution book PDF 1079-1087.

blocks.prompt: 5 (i) Express each limit in terms of \(e\). \(\lim\limits_{n \to -\infty} \left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^{2n}\).
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle shakal pehchaniye: andar \(1 + \frac{1}{n}\) jo \(1\) ke qareeb hai, aur power \(2n\) bohat bari (yahan \(n \to -\infty\), yani bohat bara negative). Yeh \(1^{\infty}\) form hai.
Book ka Note (12.2.6) kehta hai ke \(\left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^n \to e\) tab bhi hota hai jab \(n \to -\infty\).
Plan: power \(2n\) ko \(n \times 2\) likh kar extra \(2\) ko bahar nikalenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\left(1 + \dfrac{1}{n}\right)^{2n}\), \(n \to -\infty\).
Humein find karna hai: limit, \(e\) ki shakal mein.
Tareeqa: Standard limits (12.2.6): \(\lim\limits_{n \to \pm\infty} \left(1 + \dfrac{1}{n}\right)^n = e\) aur \(\lim\limits_{x \to 0} (1 + x)^{\frac{1}{x}} = e\). Shart: \(1\) ke saath jo chhoti cheez judi hai, power bilkul us ka ulta (reciprocal) ho. Power mein jo extra number bache, usay \(a^{mn} = (a^m)^n\) se bahar nikal dete hain; woh \(e\) ki power ban jata hai.

Kyun yeh seedha \(1\) nahi: andar wala hissa \(1\) ke qareeb hai lekin bilkul \(1\) nahi, aur power bohat bari hoti ja rahi hai. \(1^{\infty}\) undecided form hai (jaise \(1.001^{1000} \approx 2.7\), bilkul \(1\) nahi). Is liye \(e\) wala standard limit chahiye.

Power ko do hisson mein torein
\[\left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^{2n} = \left[\left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^{n}\right]^{2}\]
Kyun: Indices ka qanoon \(a^{mn} = (a^m)^n\). Ab andar wala bracket bilkul standard shakal mein hai: \(1\) ke saath \(\frac{1}{n}\) aur power \(n\), ek doosre ke reciprocal.

Limit lein
\[\lim_{n \to -\infty} \left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^{2n} = \left[\lim_{n \to -\infty} \left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^{n}\right]^{2}\]
\[= e^{2}\]
Kyun: Power theorem: square ka limit = limit ka square. Andar ka limit Note ke mutabiq \(n \to -\infty\) par bhi \(e\) hai.
Dhyan dein: Jawab \(2e\) nahi, \(e^2\) hai; extra number power mein jata hai, aage multiply nahi hota.

Tasdeeq
\[n = -1000:\ (0.999)^{-2000} \approx 7.396\]
\[e^2 \approx 7.389\]
Kyun: Dono values qareeb hain, aur \(n\) jitna bara (negative) karein utna aur qareeb.

blocks.prompt: 5 (ii) Express each limit in terms of \(e\). \(\lim\limits_{n \to +\infty} \left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^{\frac{n}{2}}\).
blocks.explanation:
Andar wohi standard \(1 + \frac{1}{n}\) hai, lekin power \(n\) ki jagah \(\frac{n}{2}\) hai.
Plan: \(\frac{n}{2} = n \times \frac{1}{2}\) likh kar \(\frac{1}{2}\) ko bahar nikalenge; andar \(e\) banega aur bahar square root.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\left(1 + \dfrac{1}{n}\right)^{\frac{n}{2}}\), \(n \to +\infty\).
Humein find karna hai: limit, \(e\) ki shakal mein.
Tareeqa: Standard limits (12.2.6): \(\lim\limits_{n \to \pm\infty} \left(1 + \dfrac{1}{n}\right)^n = e\) aur \(\lim\limits_{x \to 0} (1 + x)^{\frac{1}{x}} = e\). Shart: \(1\) ke saath jo chhoti cheez judi hai, power bilkul us ka ulta (reciprocal) ho. Power mein jo extra number bache, usay \(a^{mn} = (a^m)^n\) se bahar nikal dete hain; woh \(e\) ki power ban jata hai.

Power ko torein
\[\left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^{\frac{n}{2}} = \left[\left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^{n}\right]^{\frac{1}{2}}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{n}{2} = n \cdot \frac{1}{2}\), aur \(a^{mn} = (a^m)^n\). Andar ab power \(n\) hai jo \(\frac{1}{n}\) ka bilkul reciprocal hai.

Limit lein
\[\lim_{n \to +\infty} \left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^{\frac{n}{2}} = e^{\frac{1}{2}}\]
\[= \sqrt{e}\]
Kyun: Andar ka limit \(e\), aur root ka limit = limit ka root. Power \(\frac{1}{2}\) ka matlab square root hai.
Dhyan dein: \(e^{1/2}\) ko \(\frac{e}{2}\) likhna ghalat hai; aadhi power ka matlab square root hai, aadha number nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[n = 1000:\ (1.001)^{500} \approx 1.6483\]
\[\sqrt{e} \approx 1.6487\]
Kyun: Dono qareeb hain.

blocks.prompt: 5 (iii) Express each limit in terms of \(e\). \(\lim\limits_{n \to +\infty} \left(1 - \frac{1}{n}\right)^{n}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi \(1^{\infty}\) form hai, lekin andar plus ki jagah minus hai: \(1 - \frac{1}{n}\).
Standard formula "1 plus" wali shakal mangta hai. Is liye naya variable \(m = -n\) lenge; phir andar \(1 + \frac{1}{m}\) aur power \(-m\) ban jayegi.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\left(1 - \dfrac{1}{n}\right)^{n}\), \(n \to +\infty\).
Humein find karna hai: limit, \(e\) ki shakal mein.
Tareeqa: Standard limits (12.2.6): \(\lim\limits_{n \to \pm\infty} \left(1 + \dfrac{1}{n}\right)^n = e\) aur \(\lim\limits_{x \to 0} (1 + x)^{\frac{1}{x}} = e\). Shart: \(1\) ke saath jo chhoti cheez judi hai, power bilkul us ka ulta (reciprocal) ho. Power mein jo extra number bache, usay \(a^{mn} = (a^m)^n\) se bahar nikal dete hain; woh \(e\) ki power ban jata hai.

Variable badlein
\[m = -n \Rightarrow n = -m\]
\[n \to +\infty \Rightarrow m \to -\infty\]
\[\left(1 - \frac{1}{n}\right)^{n} = \left(1 + \frac{1}{m}\right)^{-m}\]
Kyun: \(-\frac{1}{n} = \frac{1}{-n} = \frac{1}{m}\). Minus sign ko variable ke andar chhupa diya, taake bracket "1 plus" wala ban jaye. Power \(n\) bhi \(-m\) ban gayi.

Power ko torein
\[\left(1 + \frac{1}{m}\right)^{-m} = \left[\left(1 + \frac{1}{m}\right)^{m}\right]^{-1}\]
Kyun: \(-m = m \times (-1)\), aur \(a^{mn} = (a^m)^n\).

Limit lein
\[\lim_{n \to +\infty} \left(1 - \frac{1}{n}\right)^{n} = e^{-1}\]
\[= \frac{1}{e}\]
Kyun: 12.2.6 ke Note ke mutabiq \(m \to -\infty\) par bhi andar ka limit \(e\) hai. Negative power ka matlab ulta (reciprocal): \(e^{-1} = \frac{1}{e}\).
Dhyan dein: Minus sign ko nazar andaaz kar ke jawab \(e\) likhna aam ghalti hai. Minus andar ho to \(e\) ki power negative ho jati hai.

Tasdeeq
\[n = 1000:\ (0.999)^{1000} \approx 0.3677\]
\[\frac{1}{e} \approx 0.3679\]
Kyun: Dono qareeb hain.

blocks.prompt: 5 (iv) Express each limit in terms of \(e\). \(\lim\limits_{n \to +\infty} \left(1 + \frac{1}{3n}\right)^{n}\).
blocks.explanation:
\(1^{\infty}\) form. Andar \(1\) ke saath \(\frac{1}{3n}\) juda hai, is liye standard shakal ke liye power \(3n\) honi chahiye, jabke sawal mein sirf \(n\) hai.
Plan: \(n = 3n \times \frac{1}{3}\) likh kar extra \(\frac{1}{3}\) ko bahar nikalenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\left(1 + \dfrac{1}{3n}\right)^{n}\), \(n \to +\infty\).
Humein find karna hai: limit, \(e\) ki shakal mein.
Tareeqa: Standard limits (12.2.6): \(\lim\limits_{n \to \pm\infty} \left(1 + \dfrac{1}{n}\right)^n = e\) aur \(\lim\limits_{x \to 0} (1 + x)^{\frac{1}{x}} = e\). Shart: \(1\) ke saath jo chhoti cheez judi hai, power bilkul us ka ulta (reciprocal) ho. Power mein jo extra number bache, usay \(a^{mn} = (a^m)^n\) se bahar nikal dete hain; woh \(e\) ki power ban jata hai.

Power ko andar wali cheez ke mutabiq banayein
\[\left(1 + \frac{1}{3n}\right)^{n} = \left[\left(1 + \frac{1}{3n}\right)^{3n}\right]^{\frac{1}{3}}\]
Kyun: \(3n \times \frac{1}{3} = n\), is liye value wohi rahi. Ab andar power \(3n\) hai jo \(\frac{1}{3n}\) ka bilkul reciprocal hai: yahi shart thi.

Limit lein
\[\lim_{n \to +\infty} \left(1 + \frac{1}{3n}\right)^{n} = e^{\frac{1}{3}}\]
Kyun: \(m = 3n\) maan lein; \(n \to +\infty\) to \(m \to +\infty\), aur \(\left(1 + \frac{1}{m}\right)^m \to e\). Bahar wala \(\frac{1}{3}\) power ban kar reh gaya.
Dhyan dein: Jawab \(e^3\) nahi, \(e^{1/3}\) hai. Seedha usool: jo number andar neeche hai (\(3\)), woh \(e\) ki power mein ulta ho kar aata hai jab sawal ki power sirf \(n\) ho.

Tasdeeq
\[n = 1000:\ \left(1 + \frac{1}{3000}\right)^{1000} \approx 1.39553\]
\[e^{\frac{1}{3}} \approx 1.39561\]
Kyun: Dono bohat qareeb hain.

blocks.prompt: 5 (v) Express each limit in terms of \(e\). \(\lim\limits_{n \to +\infty} \left(1 + \frac{4}{n}\right)^{n}\).
blocks.explanation:
\(1^{\infty}\) form. Andar \(\frac{4}{n}\) hai, jisay \(\frac{1}{n/4}\) likh sakte hain. Is liye standard shakal ke liye power \(\frac{n}{4}\) chahiye.
Plan: \(n = \frac{n}{4} \times 4\) likh kar extra \(4\) ko bahar nikalenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\left(1 + \dfrac{4}{n}\right)^{n}\), \(n \to +\infty\).
Humein find karna hai: limit, \(e\) ki shakal mein.
Tareeqa: Standard limits (12.2.6): \(\lim\limits_{n \to \pm\infty} \left(1 + \dfrac{1}{n}\right)^n = e\) aur \(\lim\limits_{x \to 0} (1 + x)^{\frac{1}{x}} = e\). Shart: \(1\) ke saath jo chhoti cheez judi hai, power bilkul us ka ulta (reciprocal) ho. Power mein jo extra number bache, usay \(a^{mn} = (a^m)^n\) se bahar nikal dete hain; woh \(e\) ki power ban jata hai.

Power ko andar wali cheez ke mutabiq banayein
\[\left(1 + \frac{4}{n}\right)^{n} = \left[\left(1 + \frac{4}{n}\right)^{\frac{n}{4}}\right]^{4}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{n}{4} \times 4 = n\), value wohi. Andar power \(\frac{n}{4}\) ab \(\frac{4}{n}\) ka bilkul reciprocal hai.

Limit lein
\[\lim_{n \to +\infty} \left(1 + \frac{4}{n}\right)^{n} = e^{4}\]
Kyun: \(m = \frac{n}{4}\) maan lein; to \(\frac{4}{n} = \frac{1}{m}\) aur \(m \to +\infty\). Andar ka bracket \(e\) ki taraf, aur bahar ki power \(4\).
Dhyan dein: Aam qayda yaad rakhein: \(\left(1 + \frac{k}{n}\right)^n \to e^k\). Part (iv) mein \(k = \frac{1}{3}\) tha, yahan \(k = 4\).

Tasdeeq
\[n = 100000:\ (1.00004)^{100000} \approx 54.594\]
\[e^4 \approx 54.598\]
Kyun: Dono qareeb hain. (Chhoti \(n\) par farq zyada hota hai, is liye bara \(n\) liya.)

blocks.prompt: 5 (vi) Express each limit in terms of \(e\). \(\lim\limits_{x \to 0} (1 + 3x)^{\frac{2}{x}}\).
blocks.explanation:
\(x \to 0\) par andar \(1 + 3x \to 1\) aur power \(\frac{2}{x}\) bohat bari: \(1^{\infty}\) form.
Yahan doosra standard limit kaam aayega: \(\lim\limits_{h \to 0} (1 + h)^{1/h} = e\), jahan \(h = 3x\). Is ke liye power \(\frac{1}{3x}\) honi chahiye.
Plan: \(\frac{2}{x} = \frac{1}{3x} \times 6\) likh kar \(6\) ko bahar nikalenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \((1 + 3x)^{\frac{2}{x}}\), \(x \to 0\).
Humein find karna hai: limit, \(e\) ki shakal mein.
Tareeqa: Standard limits (12.2.6): \(\lim\limits_{n \to \pm\infty} \left(1 + \dfrac{1}{n}\right)^n = e\) aur \(\lim\limits_{x \to 0} (1 + x)^{\frac{1}{x}} = e\). Shart: \(1\) ke saath jo chhoti cheez judi hai, power bilkul us ka ulta (reciprocal) ho. Power mein jo extra number bache, usay \(a^{mn} = (a^m)^n\) se bahar nikal dete hain; woh \(e\) ki power ban jata hai.

Power ko andar wali cheez ke mutabiq banayein
\[(1 + 3x)^{\frac{2}{x}} = \left[(1 + 3x)^{\frac{1}{3x}}\right]^{6}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{3x} \times 6 = \frac{6}{3x} = \frac{2}{x}\), value wohi. Andar \(3x\) aur power \(\frac{1}{3x}\) ek doosre ke reciprocal hain.

Limit lein
\[\lim_{x \to 0} (1 + 3x)^{\frac{2}{x}} = e^{6}\]
Kyun: \(h = 3x\) maan lein; \(x \to 0\) to \(h \to 0\), aur \((1 + h)^{1/h} \to e\). Bahar wala \(6\) \(e\) ki power ban gaya.
Dhyan dein: \(6\) kahan se aaya? Andar ka \(3\) aur power ka \(2\): \(3 \times 2 = 6\). Sirf \(2\) ya sirf \(3\) likhna ghalat hai.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 0.001:\ (1.003)^{2000} \approx 399.8\]
\[e^6 \approx 403.4\]
Kyun: Qareeb hai, aur \(x\) aur chhota karne se aur qareeb hota jata hai.

blocks.prompt: 5 (vii) Express each limit in terms of \(e\). \(\lim\limits_{x \to 0} (1 + 2x^2)^{\frac{1}{x^2}}\).
blocks.explanation:
\(x \to 0\) par \(1^{\infty}\) form. Andar \(1\) ke saath \(2x^2\) juda hai, is liye power \(\frac{1}{2x^2}\) honi chahiye, jabke sawal mein \(\frac{1}{x^2}\) hai.
Plan: \(\frac{1}{x^2} = \frac{1}{2x^2} \times 2\) likh kar \(2\) ko bahar nikalenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \((1 + 2x^2)^{\frac{1}{x^2}}\), \(x \to 0\).
Humein find karna hai: limit, \(e\) ki shakal mein.
Tareeqa: Standard limits (12.2.6): \(\lim\limits_{n \to \pm\infty} \left(1 + \dfrac{1}{n}\right)^n = e\) aur \(\lim\limits_{x \to 0} (1 + x)^{\frac{1}{x}} = e\). Shart: \(1\) ke saath jo chhoti cheez judi hai, power bilkul us ka ulta (reciprocal) ho. Power mein jo extra number bache, usay \(a^{mn} = (a^m)^n\) se bahar nikal dete hain; woh \(e\) ki power ban jata hai.

Power ko andar wali cheez ke mutabiq banayein
\[(1 + 2x^2)^{\frac{1}{x^2}} = \left[(1 + 2x^2)^{\frac{1}{2x^2}}\right]^{2}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{2x^2} \times 2 = \frac{1}{x^2}\), value wohi rahi; andar \(2x^2\) aur \(\frac{1}{2x^2}\) reciprocal hain.

Limit lein
\[\lim_{x \to 0} (1 + 2x^2)^{\frac{1}{x^2}} = e^{2}\]
Kyun: \(h = 2x^2\) maan lein; \(x \to 0\) to \(h \to 0\), aur \((1 + h)^{1/h} \to e\). Bahar ki power \(2\).
Dhyan dein: Yahan \(x^2\) se ghabrayein nahi; \(h\) koi bhi cheez ho sakti hai jo zero ki taraf jaye, bas power us ka ulta honi chahiye.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 0.01:\ (1.0002)^{10000} \approx 7.3876\]
\[e^2 \approx 7.3891\]
Kyun: Dono qareeb hain.

blocks.prompt: 5 (viii) Express each limit in terms of \(e\). \(\lim\limits_{h \to 0} (1 - 2h)^{\frac{1}{h}}\).
blocks.explanation:
\(h \to 0\) par \(1^{\infty}\) form. Andar \(1\) ke saath \(-2h\) juda hai (minus sign samet), is liye power \(\frac{1}{-2h}\) honi chahiye.
Plan: \(\frac{1}{h} = \frac{1}{-2h} \times (-2)\) likh kar \(-2\) ko bahar nikalenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \((1 - 2h)^{\frac{1}{h}}\), \(h \to 0\).
Humein find karna hai: limit, \(e\) ki shakal mein.
Tareeqa: Standard limits (12.2.6): \(\lim\limits_{n \to \pm\infty} \left(1 + \dfrac{1}{n}\right)^n = e\) aur \(\lim\limits_{x \to 0} (1 + x)^{\frac{1}{x}} = e\). Shart: \(1\) ke saath jo chhoti cheez judi hai, power bilkul us ka ulta (reciprocal) ho. Power mein jo extra number bache, usay \(a^{mn} = (a^m)^n\) se bahar nikal dete hain; woh \(e\) ki power ban jata hai.

Power ko andar wali cheez ke mutabiq banayein
\[(1 - 2h)^{\frac{1}{h}} = \left[\big(1 + (-2h)\big)^{\frac{1}{-2h}}\right]^{-2}\]
Kyun: \(1 - 2h = 1 + (-2h)\). Phir \(\frac{1}{-2h} \times (-2) = \frac{1}{h}\), value wohi rahi. Andar \(-2h\) aur \(\frac{1}{-2h}\) bilkul reciprocal hain.

Limit lein
\[\lim_{h \to 0} (1 - 2h)^{\frac{1}{h}} = e^{-2}\]
\[= \frac{1}{e^{2}}\]
Kyun: \(u = -2h\) maan lein; \(h \to 0\) to \(u \to 0\) aur \((1 + u)^{1/u} \to e\). Bahar ki power \(-2\), aur \(e^{-2} = \frac{1}{e^2}\).
Dhyan dein: Minus sign ko power mein le jana na bhoolein, warna jawab \(e^2\) aa jayega jo ghalat hai.

Tasdeeq
\[h = 0.001:\ (0.998)^{1000} \approx 0.13506\]
\[e^{-2} \approx 0.13534\]
Kyun: Dono qareeb hain; \(1\) se chhota number bari power par chhota hi hota hai, is liye jawab \(1\) se kam hona hi tha.

blocks.prompt: 5 (ix) Express each limit in terms of \(e\). \(\lim\limits_{x \to \infty} \left(\frac{x}{1 + x}\right)^{x}\).
blocks.explanation:
Bari \(x\) par \(\frac{x}{1 + x}\) qareeb qareeb \(1\) hai (jaise \(\frac{1000}{1001} \approx 0.999\)) aur power \(x\) bohat bari: \(1^{\infty}\) form.
Lekin bracket abhi "1 plus kuch" shakal mein nahi. Fraction ko ulta karne se \(1 + \frac{1}{x}\) saamne aa jata hai.
Plan: \(\frac{x}{1 + x} = \frac{1}{1 + \frac{1}{x}}\) likhenge, phir neeche standard limit.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\left(\dfrac{x}{1 + x}\right)^{x}\), \(x \to \infty\).
Humein find karna hai: limit, \(e\) ki shakal mein.
Tareeqa: Standard limits (12.2.6): \(\lim\limits_{n \to \pm\infty} \left(1 + \dfrac{1}{n}\right)^n = e\) aur \(\lim\limits_{x \to 0} (1 + x)^{\frac{1}{x}} = e\). Shart: \(1\) ke saath jo chhoti cheez judi hai, power bilkul us ka ulta (reciprocal) ho. Power mein jo extra number bache, usay \(a^{mn} = (a^m)^n\) se bahar nikal dete hain; woh \(e\) ki power ban jata hai.

Fraction ko ulta karein
\[\frac{x}{1 + x} = \frac{1}{\dfrac{1 + x}{x}}\]
\[= \frac{1}{1 + \dfrac{1}{x}}\]
Kyun: Har fraction apne reciprocal ka ulta hota hai: \(\frac{a}{b} = \frac{1}{b/a}\). Aur \(\frac{1 + x}{x} = \frac{1}{x} + \frac{x}{x} = 1 + \frac{1}{x}\). Ab woh standard bracket nazar aa gaya.

Power lagayein
\[\left(\frac{x}{1 + x}\right)^{x} = \frac{1}{\left(1 + \dfrac{1}{x}\right)^{x}}\]
Kyun: Fraction ki power: upar ki power over neeche ki power, aur \(1^x = 1\).

Limit lein
\[\lim_{x \to \infty} \left(\frac{x}{1 + x}\right)^{x} = \frac{1}{e}\]
Kyun: Neeche standard limit se \(e\) aata hai jo zero nahi, is liye quotient theorem lagta hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\frac{x}{1 + x} \to 1\) dekh kar jawab \(1\) likh dena sab se aam ghalti hai; \(1^{\infty}\) ka jawab \(1\) nahi hota.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 1000:\ \left(\frac{1000}{1001}\right)^{1000} \approx 0.3681\]
\[\frac{1}{e} \approx 0.3679\]
Kyun: Dono qareeb hain.

blocks.prompt: 5 (x) Express each limit in terms of \(e\). \(\lim\limits_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{\frac{1}{x}} - 1}{e^{\frac{1}{x}} - 1},\ x < 0\).
blocks.explanation:
Ghaur se dekhein: jaisa chhapa hai, upar aur neeche bilkul ek jaise hain. To fraction har \(x \ne 0\) par \(1\) hai aur limit bhi \(1\); is mein kuch dhoondne ko hai hi nahi.
Part (xi) aur answer key (\(-1\)) batate hain ke asal denominator \(e^{1/x} + 1\) hai. Yani chhapai ki ghalti hai.
Plan: dekhenge ke negative taraf se \(x \to 0\) ho to \(e^{1/x}\) kya karta hai, phir asal fraction mein rakhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai (jaisa chhapa): \(\dfrac{e^{1/x} - 1}{e^{1/x} - 1}\), \(x \to 0\), \(x < 0\).
Humein find karna hai: limit.
Tareeqa: Yaad rakhne wale results (12.2.7): \(t \to -\infty\) par \(e^{t} \to 0\), aur \(t \to +\infty\) par \(e^{t} \to \infty\).

Chhapa hua sawal
\[\frac{e^{1/x} - 1}{e^{1/x} - 1} = 1 \quad (x \ne 0)\]
\[\lim_{x \to 0^-} 1 = 1\]
Kyun: \(x < 0\) par \(e^{1/x}\) kabhi \(1\) nahi hota, is liye upar neeche barabar aur non-zero hain, fraction \(1\) hai. Constant ka limit wohi constant.

Asal (intended) sawal: \(\dfrac{1}{x}\) kya karta hai
\[\lim_{x \to 0^-} \frac{e^{1/x} - 1}{e^{1/x} + 1}\]
\[x \to 0^- \Rightarrow \frac{1}{x} \to -\infty\]
Kyun: \(x\) negative aur bohat chhota hai, jaise \(x = -0.001\) to \(\frac{1}{x} = -1000\). Chhote negative number ka ulta bohat bara negative number hota hai. \(0^-\) ka matlab hai bayen (negative) taraf se zero ki taraf aana.

\(e^{1/x}\) kya karta hai
\[e^{1/x} \to 0\]
Kyun: \(e\) ki bari negative power bohat chhoti hoti hai: \(e^{-1000} = \frac{1}{e^{1000}}\), jo zero ke bilkul qareeb hai.
Dhyan dein: \(e^{1/x}\) kabhi negative nahi hota; woh sirf zero ke qareeb jata hai.

Value rakhein
\[\lim_{x \to 0^-} \frac{e^{1/x} - 1}{e^{1/x} + 1} = \frac{0 - 1}{0 + 1}\]
\[= -1\]
Kyun: Neeche \(1\) hai, zero nahi, is liye quotient theorem lagta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[x = -0.01:\ \frac{e^{-100} - 1}{e^{-100} + 1} \approx -1\]
Kyun: \(e^{-100}\) amali tor par zero hai. Exam mein agar paper par neeche \(e^{1/x} + 1\) ho to jawab \(-1\) likhein.
blocks.final_answer: Jaisa chhapa: \(1\). Asal sawal \(\lim\limits_{x \to 0} \dfrac{e^{1/x} - 1}{e^{1/x} + 1} = -1\), \(x < 0\) (key wala jawab).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein part (x) ka denominator \(e^{1/x} - 1\) chhapa hai, jo numerator jaisa hi hai; is tarah fraction har jagah \(1\) aur limit \(1\) banta hai. Part (xi) aur answer key (\(-1\)) se saaf hai ke asal denominator \(e^{1/x} + 1\) hai, jis se negative taraf se \(x \to 0\) par limit \(-1\) aata hai.

blocks.prompt: 5 (xi) Express each limit in terms of \(e\). \(\lim\limits_{x \to 0} \frac{e^{\frac{1}{x}} - 1}{e^{\frac{1}{x}} + 1},\ x > 0\).
blocks.explanation:
Ab \(x\) positive taraf se zero ki taraf aa raha hai, is liye \(\frac{1}{x} \to +\infty\) aur \(e^{1/x}\) bohat bara: upar neeche dono bare, \(\infty/\infty\).
Plan: upar aur neeche ko \(e^{1/x}\) se divide karenge, taake \(e^{-1/x}\) aaye jo zero ki taraf jata hai. Part (x) se muqabla karein: wahan \(x < 0\) tha aur jawab \(-1\) aaya; yahan \(x > 0\) hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\dfrac{e^{1/x} - 1}{e^{1/x} + 1}\), \(x \to 0\), \(x > 0\).
Humein find karna hai: limit.
Tareeqa: Yaad rakhne wale results (12.2.7): \(t \to +\infty\) par \(e^{t} \to \infty\), aur \(t \to -\infty\) par \(e^{t} \to 0\).

\(\dfrac{1}{x}\) aur \(e^{1/x}\) kya karte hain
\[x \to 0^+ \Rightarrow \frac{1}{x} \to +\infty\]
\[e^{1/x} \to \infty\]
Kyun: Chhota positive \(x\), jaise \(0.001\), ka ulta \(1000\) hai: bohat bara positive. \(e\) ki bohat bari power bohat bari hoti hai. Is liye \(\infty/\infty\).

Upar aur neeche ko \(e^{1/x}\) se divide karein
\[\frac{e^{1/x} - 1}{e^{1/x} + 1} = \frac{1 - e^{-1/x}}{1 + e^{-1/x}}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{e^{1/x}} = e^{-1/x}\). Ek hi non-zero number se upar neeche divide karne se value nahi badalti. Yeh bilkul Q1 wala tareeqa hai: sab se tez barhne wali cheez se divide karo.

Limit lein
\[\lim_{x \to 0^+} \frac{1 - e^{-1/x}}{1 + e^{-1/x}} = \frac{1 - 0}{1 + 0}\]
\[= 1\]
Kyun: \(-\frac{1}{x} \to -\infty\), is liye \(e^{-1/x} \to 0\). Neeche \(1\) bacha, zero nahi.
Dhyan dein: Dono parts (x) aur (xi) mein fraction wohi hai, sirf \(x\) ki taraf badli, aur jawab \(-1\) se \(1\) ho gaya. Is liye is function ka \(x \to 0\) par do-tarfa (two-sided) limit mojood nahi; yeh baat 12.3 mein one-sided limits mein aayegi.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 0.01:\ \frac{e^{100} - 1}{e^{100} + 1} \approx 1\]
Kyun: \(e^{100}\) itna bara hai ke us mein \(1\) jama ya minus karne se taqreeban koi farq nahi parta.
